headline: Trabzonspor in form, but the market keeps the derby close
summary: Trabzonspor bring four straight league wins to the Black Sea derby, the latest 2-0 at home to Beşiktaş. Rizespor have won once in their last five, so the form book points one way. Turkish media say Paul Onuachu is doubtful for the visitors. Across eight bookmakers, with the margin removed, Trabzonspor are 45.3% to win at Rizespor, against 29.6% for the home side. They are favourites, yet rated only about a third of a goal better — which is why this derby still looks tight.
read: Trabzonspor are the form side of the Süper Lig — four straight wins, 13 goals in five, Salah leading the scoring charts — and they arrive at the Black Sea derby as favourites. The market still calls it close: Rizespor are given a home chance of nearly 30%, the handicap is only a third of a goal, and three goals are expected.

facts.fact: Trabzonspor have won their last four matches, most recently 2-0 at home to Beşiktaş on Sunday.
facts.meaning: They arrive at the Black Sea derby as the form team in the division.

facts.fact: Trabzonspor are 45.3% to win at Rizespor, against 29.6% for the home side.
facts.meaning: Favourites, but only around one and a half times Rizespor's chance — not a one-sided derby.

facts.fact: Mohamed Salah tops the Süper Lig scoring charts with eight goals in eight games.
facts.meaning: Rizespor's back line faces the league's leading scorer in a derby they need to keep tight.

facts.fact: Thomas Reis confirmed Paul Onuachu and Mustafa Eskihellaç will miss the Hearts game, and said Onuachu is doubtful for Rizespor.
facts.meaning: Trabzonspor may be without their target man for the derby, days after a European tie.

facts.fact: The market rates Trabzonspor only about a third of a goal better, with the fair handicap line at +0.33 in Rizespor's favour at home.
Trabzonspor's win chance has slipped from 46.9% to 44.9% in the last two days, even after the Beşiktaş win.
facts.meaning: The market rates this away derby tighter than the form book suggests.

facts.fact: Trabzonspor are averaging 2.21 expected goals per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They are not riding luck — they are creating enough chances to win games comfortably.

facts.fact: Rizespor have won once in five and lost 0-3 at home to Fenerbahçe on 10 October.
facts.meaning: Home form is their soft spot going into the biggest home game of their autumn.

sources.fact: Trabzonspor beat fierce rivals Beşiktaş 2-0 in the Süper Lig, with Mohamed Salah scoring the second goal.
Trabzonspor coach Thomas Reis said Paul Onuachu and Mustafa Eskihellaç will not feature against Hearts, and Onuachu is doubtful for the Rizespor match.
Thomas Reis warned that Hearts' heavy 7-1 defeat to Celtic makes them dangerous, saying they will want to prove it was a mistake and show a strong response.
Trabzonspor are on a four-match winning run and are looking to extend it to five against Hearts, according to Daily Sabah.
Mohamed Salah tops the Süper Lig goal charts with eight goals in the opening eight rounds, per Daily Sabah.
Trabzonspor defender Stefan Savic believes his team can raise their level even further after beating Beşiktaş.
Rizespor host Trabzonspor in a Black Sea derby, with defender Modibo Sagnan speaking about the match.
Rizespor began preparations for the Trabzonspor match under coach Recep Uçar with passing and tactical work at the Mehmet Cengiz facilities.
